niche.habitat: Upper canopy near iron-rich basalt forests & magnetic anomaly plumes. Evolves here because dense copper haze & frequent flares wash out visual contrast, while strong 0.8 mT fields provide stable 3D topology. Radical-pair cryptochromes exploit this gradient to navigate & hunt regardless of light.

body: Broad, torsion-stiffened wings with cryptochrome-rich retinal overlay; helical bone struts for magnetic stealth; ventral photophore patches for counter-illumination.

relations.note: (council kind 'Competitor') Juveniles of Cromabuceo drop to vent plains; adults hunt dropped juveniles when magnetotactic plumes overlap.
(council kind 'Prey') Grazes on electro-plankton that cluster along magnetic gradient edges.
(council kind 'Predator') Adults ambush juvenile Cromavolante when they descend to feed on vent microplankton.

temperament: Solitary, territorial, highly sensitive to field distortions.
secrets: Cryptochrome density peaks in the cornea; surgical extraction yields a stable compass vial.
Mates synchronize wing-ripple frequencies to align magnetic dipoles before copulation.
moments: At noon, when the copper haze thickens, it opens its wings and the field lines snap into focus—visible as faint, shimmering ribbons of silver dust, guiding it through the forest like a blind man reading braille.

journal.en: It navigates by the planet's heartbeat.
Flares don't blind it; they sharpen its hunger.
